quests.name: Short on Willow Logs
quests.summary: The banker of Lorowick has run out of willow logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 willow logs and nobody in Lorowick has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Armour Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Lorowick to the armour shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the armour shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Sword Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the sword shop keeper of Lorowick and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the sword shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Lorowick Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Lorowick Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Lorowick Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the zombie near Lorowick thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 8 of them close to Lorowick and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Lorowick has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 10 bones and nobody in Lorowick has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Magic Shop Keeper

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Clothes Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the clothes shop keeper of Lorowick and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the clothes shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Supply Run to Velneir
quests.summary: Gather willow logs for the banker, then carry a shipment to Velneir.
intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 16 willow logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Lorowick.
From Lorowick? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Lorowick and bring back iron bar.
intro: The wilds around Lorowick need a firm hand. Start with 8 giant rat outside the walls, then 13 giant spider down in Lorowick Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 8 iron bar to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Lorowick for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the staff shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Lorowick Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Lorowick Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Lorowick Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 13 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Lorowick owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Lorowick Sewers is clearer than it was. 13 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: The Lorowick Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Lorowick and Velneir.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Velneir. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 19 zombie near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Lorowick.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Velneir is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Lorowick has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Lorowick
quests.summary: Find what rules Lorowick Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Lorowick Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the realtor what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Lorowick is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Lorowick Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Fallen Warden
quests.summary: March on Meadow Keep, break its creatures and bring down The Fallen Warden.
intro: Meadow Keep has stood against Lorowick for too long. The Fallen Warden sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the barber, fight your way through 19 zombie and end The Fallen Warden.
Bring 13 raw trout back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Meadow Keep?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Fallen Warden rules it now.
player: Word from Lorowick: The Fallen Warden is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
